en: Hello drivers, <cf>EA Sports WRC’s 1.5 update is now live!<cf>This update contains many changes to improve the game-play experience of EA Sports WRC, addressing on-stage stutters, framerate, corner cutting, and more…<cf>Also included in this update is the livery of 2023 WRC2 Champion Andreas Mikkelsen, available on the Škoda Fabia RS Rally2 found in the WRC2 class.<cf>To review the full patch notes please scan the QR code or visit EA Answers HQ.

Hello Drivers,<cf>EA Sports WRC’s 1.6 update is now live!<cf>This update includes a variety of bug fixes, with key work including a fix to a recurring crash when playing Rallye Monte-Carlo in cockpit camera, and improvements to stability and reduced stuttering to multiple other locations.<cf>Additionally we have added official support for the Turtle Beach VelocityOne Race Wheel and Pedals.<cf>You can view the full patch notes by scanning the QR Code or by going to EA Answers HQ.<cf>See you on the stages!

Hello Drivers,<cf>EA Sports WRC’s 1.7 update is now live!<cf>This update includes a variety of bug fixes, with key work including improvements to rain VFX, fixes to dust and snow kickups in Replays, and framerate improvements to all locations. <cf>Additionally we have addressed an issue affecting Vibration & Feedback settings on PS5 controllers. <cf>You can view the full patch notes by scanning the QR Code or by going to EA Answers HQ.<cf>See you on the stages!

Hello Drivers,<cf>EA Sports WRC’s 1.8 update is now live!<cf>This update contains the highly anticipated inclusion of VR Beta for all PC players, in addition to a variety of fixes to Clubs and other features across the game!<cf>You can view the full patch notes, and the VR Beta FAQ, by scanning the QR Code or by going to EA Answers HQ.<cf>See you on the stages!

Welcome EA Play Members!<cf><cf>To support you on your new EA SPORTS WRC journey and to familiarise you with the exciting world of rallying, we want to highlight a few key features to get you started. We have a complete suite of Driving Assists (in Options & Extras) to tailor the on-stage experience to your liking. In addition, there is a Damage Difficulty option where you can set the vehicle damage to Visual Only, removing the need to worry about your vehicle's mechanical wear and tear.<cf><cf>Lastly, we have the EA SPORTS WRC - The Ultimate Beginner’s Guide that contains a host of handy tips, covering everything you will need to know to hit the stages fast and secure those podium finishes!<cf><cf>Simply scan the QR code to access the full guide.<cf><cf>See you on the stages!

Hello drivers,<cf><cf>Our upcoming v1.4.0 patch will release on [date], and contain several bug fixes and improvements across EA SPORTS™ WRC.<cf><cf>One fix relates to steering wheel and controller input bindings not working correctly across certain device configurations.<cf><cf>In order to fix this issue, a complete wipe of all custom input bindings is required, for all players.<cf><cf>We know that many of you have spent a lot of time refining your controller, wheel and pedal setups, so in order to provide the least disruption possible, we are sending this warning ahead of time.<cf><cf>If you wish to keep any bindings after the v1.4.0 update releases, we recommend you screenshot or write down the button bindings you are currently using, and then re-apply them after the patch is released.<cf><cf>Thank you for your support and understanding.<cf><cf>

Hello drivers,<cf><cf>Our upcoming v1.4.0 patch will release on [date], and contain several bug fixes and improvements across EA SPORTS™ WRC.<cf><cf>One fix relates to some tuning setups potentially breaking when a player tunes multiple cars.<cf><cf>In order to fix this issue, a complete wipe of all tuning setups is required, for all players.<cf><cf>We know that many of you have spent a lot of time refining your tuning setups, so in order to provide the least disruption possible, we are sending this warning ahead of time.<cf><cf>If you wish to keep any tuning setups after the v1.4.0 update releases, we recommend you screenshot or write down the tuning values for those setups now, and then re-apply them after the patch is released.<cf><cf>Thank you for your support and understanding.
